name: Raptus
source: A young boy has been locked for several years in a mental health facility because of his illness and the crimes he committed as a kid, finally free to return to his past life he can't wait to fulfill his desires and let out all the anger and hate he built up in these years.
translation: 一个小男孩因为疾病和小时候犯下的罪行而被关在精神病院里几年，终于可以自由地回到过去的生活，他迫不及待地想要实现自己的愿望，发泄这些年来积累的所有愤怒和仇恨。
